records.title: 10-K
records.text: In 2024, we generated $1,042.4 million in total revenue, with a revenue mix of: cloud subscriptions 32%; software license 1%; maintenance 13%; services revenue 51%; and hardware 3%.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Cloud Subscriptions and Software License revenue: In the full year ended 2024, cloud subscriptions revenue was 96% of total cloud and software license revenue.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our international revenue was approximately $346.2 million, $301.4 million, and $238.4 million for the years ended December 31, 2024, 2023 and 2022, respectively, which represents approximately 33%, 32%, and 31% of our total revenue for the years ended December 31, 2024, 2023 and 2022, respectively.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our R&D expenses for the years ended December 31, 2024, 2023 and 2022 were $137.7 million, $126.8 million, and $111.9 million, respectively.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: For 2024, we generated cash flow from operating activities of $295.0 million and have generated a cumulative total of $720.9 million for the three years ended December 31, 2024.
